summary: Comprehensive backend+frontend smoke tests for UnlockVault (PDF/Excel mass password unlocker). All 7 backend endpoints exercised against the external REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL; full UI flow exercised via Playwright including upload, match, unlock, filter, merge, delete, theme toggle.
passed: POST /api/upload: locked.pdf detected encrypted=true status=locked; plain.pdf detected encrypted=false status=ready
POST /api/match-passwords: tried [wrong, pw123] -> matched_count=1, correct matched_password=pw123, non-encrypted left as ready
POST /api/unlock: locked file became status=unlocked, encrypted=false
GET /api/download/{sid}/{fid}: downloaded PDF opens WITHOUT password via pikepdf (confirmed)
GET /api/download-zip/{sid}: ZIP contains original filenames [locked.pdf, plain.pdf]
POST /api/merge-pdf: 2 PDFs merged, new file is_merged=true, status=unlocked
POST /api/merge-pdf with 1 file -> 400 'Select at least 2 PDF files to merge' as expected
POST /api/replace: content swapped, encryption re-detected (plain->locked => status=locked)
Frontend UI: dropzone upload populates 2 rows with correct status badges (Locked, No Password)
Frontend UI: Match Passwords updates row to Matched; Unlock All updates row to Unlocked
Frontend UI: filter-unlocked shows only 1 row (unlocked PDF)
Frontend UI: Merge PDF dialog opens, confirm-merge creates 3rd merged row
Frontend UI: Delete dialog + confirm removes row
Frontend UI: Theme toggle switches html class dark -> '' (light)
Frontend UI: Download ZIP button enabled when unlocked files exist
notes: Excel encrypted path not tested (encrypted .xlsx generation non-trivial, as flagged acceptable in request). Non-encrypted path for any extension is covered via plain.pdf behavior (status=ready). Core PDF locked->unlock->download-opens-without-password flow fully verified end-to-end.
